protocol.method: All32candidate x base/stress64daily account returnseries share circular calendar blocks sampled separately within eachwindow, preserving original213/760daycounts. N=973, dailymeansweightedbydays. Pointwise95%percentile intervals (floorB*.025/floorB*.975) are notsimultaneous. White-inspired least-favorable centered circular-block max-mean diagnostic: cash family x_j=r_j all64; incremental family x_j=r_j-r_baseline_samecost excludesbaseline self (62). mu_j mean; T_j=sqrtN*max(0,mu_j), T_family=maxT_j; Z_b=max(0,max_j sqrtN*(mu*_bj-mu_j)); p=(1+count[Z_b>=T])/(B+1), nonpositive mean p1. No studentization or dropping weak rules. Bothglobal and eachcandidate adjustedp reported, both7/28block lengths fixed. Centring all means atzero isleastfavorable and conservative; windows treatedfixedstrata. NotSPA,DSRorproject-wide correction.
protocol.acceptance: Historical criteria only, no live/prospective certification. Frozen selected must be developmentqualified; >=180validationdays, >=100closedtrades total and>=10eachsymbol underbothcosts; bothwindows netpositive anddailydrawdown>=-10%underbothcosts; selected absolutelower95CI>0 for7/28blocksandbothcosts; selected cash-family adjustedp<=.05for7/28blocksandbothcosts. Global significance ofanother candidate cannot qualifyselected. Incrementalrelativebaselinep reportedbutnotrequired. Failure=>not-established,no replacement. Passing=>historical-criteria-passedwithknown/adaptivelimits.

acceptance.meaning: Known-history research only, not new out-of-sample or live evidence; no reselection, automatic deployment or guarantee.

conventions.bootstrapPairing: same within-window date indices for all candidates, costs and both null families
conventions.interval: Pointwise 95% percentile, sorted ranks floor(samples*.025) and floor(samples*.975); not simultaneous bands.
conventions.statistic: sqrt(N) * max(0, mean); unstudentized, N is total validation days
conventions.nullStatistic: max(0, max_j sqrt(N) * (bootstrapMean_j - observedMean_j)); center every series at zero
conventions.ties: Conservative math.isclose rel_tol=1e-12, abs_tol=1e-14 on scaled statistics
conventions.cashFamily: all declared candidates x base/stress, including development-ineligible rules
conventions.incrementalFamily: non-baseline candidates x base/stress minus baseline at the same cost

method.name: White-inspired least-favorable centered circular-block max-mean diagnostic

limitations: All validation history is already known; the procedure cannot undo prior adaptive design or project-wide searches.
This is an unstudentized least-favorable max test, not SPA, DSR, a stepdown procedure or an exact finite-sample test.
Weak-dependence/stability assumptions within windows are not established. Fixed window-stratified circular blocks differ from White's original stationary-bootstrap implementation.
High-variance or poor candidates can make this max test conservative; none are removed after viewing validation results.
Cash and incremental families and both block lengths are reported separately, without a joint-family significance claim. Global rejection does not certify the frozen selected rule.
Only the selected rule's absolute lower bounds and selected cash-family adjusted p-values enter historical acceptance; baseline increments are descriptive.
Per-window resets are not a continuous investment record. Complete account differences include changed positions, risk states and subsequent entries.

selection.criterion: Exactly once: highest development BASE-cost daily portfolio Sharpe among all32declared candidates with finite Sharpe and>=30closed trades in EACH of six symbols. Ties follow declared order. Separate >=4profitable symbols and positive median-symbol-meanR qualification does not trigger reselection on failure. Stress is not available on development and cannot influence this selection. No later-window choice or fallback winner; if no eligible candidate stop without inspecting validation. Every candidate is reported thereafter, including ineligible and losing families.
